context.description: Number of seconds from the input video to use as context for the extension (minimum 1 second, maximum 20 seconds). If not provided, defaults to maximize available context within the 505 frame limit.

duration.description: Duration in seconds to extend the video. Minimum 2 seconds, maximum 20 seconds.
duration.title: Duration

mode.description: Where to extend the video: 'end' extends at the end, 'start' extends at the beginning.
mode.title: Mode

prompt.description: Description of what should happen in the extended portion of the video.
prompt.title: Prompt

video_url.description: The URL of the video to extend
video_url.title: Video Url
